official.licence_note: Canary-1B-v2 is NVIDIA's model (CC-BY-4.0, attribution required); this is the ONNX export by istupakov. Its outputs carry no restriction.
official.description: NVIDIA Canary-1B-v2 (about 1B parameters) on onnxruntime, int8 files by default (1.0 GB; full precision 4 GB): clean text with punctuation and capitals in 25 European languages, no fillers or repetitions. The Czech FLEURS word error rate on its model card is 7.86% (self-reported, read speech). About 4 times slower than Parakeet on a CPU, and the more accurate of the two. onnx-asr gives it no token times: the words are timed by the align stage (forced alignment).

official.licence_note: Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 is NVIDIA's model (CC-BY-4.0, attribution required); this is the ONNX export by istupakov. Its outputs carry no restriction.
official.description: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 (0.6B parameters) on onnxruntime, int8 files by default (0.7 GB; full precision 2.6 GB): the same 25 languages as Canary, finds the language itself, much faster (tens of times real time on a CPU), a little less accurate.
